verdict.rationale: Datacenter-scale interconnect and deployment is a fair axis for a GPU, so the story applies. The evidence documents only PCIe Gen 5 host bandwidth and MIG partitioning of a single card, and it positions the part as a desktop card that avoids data center resources. There is no documented NVLink or equivalent GPU-to-GPU interconnect, no vendor-supported multi-GPU system, and no rack-scale deployment. The community's four-card build is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit; MIG and PCIe are adjacent features.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment
